dedupe_keys.name: damages and losses to the gaza electricity distribution company fleet machinery and generators during the war 2023 2025

description: This white paper analyses the damage to the vehicle fleet, heavy machinery and electric generators of the Gaza Electricity Distribution Company (GEDCO) during the war from October 2023 to February 2025. It was published on Zenodo in May 2025 by Mervat Sabbah, Mohammad Baraqouni and Mohammed Al-Astal of GEDCO. The study documents the scale of physical damage and its effect on operational capacity, emergency response and support services. It finds that 67 percent of vehicles and machinery and 50 percent of generators were affected, with an estimated loss of 5.62 million US dollars, which disrupted community relief, municipal support, repair logistics and emergency interventions. It aims to support recovery planning and is offered as a case of utility asset vulnerability in prolonged conflict. Coverage is the GEDCO service area in the Gaza Strip. The paper is one PDF of about 1.3 MB, accessible from Zenodo under CC BY-ND 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: it covers support assets, not the network itself, and it was written by the affected utility during ongoing conflict. Simulation uses are estimating repair crew and logistics capacity loss for restoration models under conflict. Related records: data-uk-power-station-transformer-dga-2010-2015 is another asset condition record.
